name: keys.openpgp.org verifying keyserver (VKS API)
tier_rationale: Well-known community project with an identifiable team, published usage policy and privacy policy and years of public track record (A8 community): 'Tier community (keys.openpgp.org ...)' (P091 chair rationale).

reliability.justification: Only user IDs whose e-mail address the key owner confirmed are published: a verified address is a PROBABLE identity link (P091 cond 3); the name part of a UID stays self-asserted.

vks.title: VKS by-email / by-fingerprint (GET https://keys.openpgp.org/vks/v1/by-email/<address> | /vks/v1/by-fingerprint/<FPR>): ASCII-armored key with e-mail-verified UIDs only

terms.quote: Tier community (keys.openpgp.org; Canonical's keyserver is trusted); terms open.

vks.notes: Research C0210 (verified_live 200/404). 404 'No key found for email address ...' = 'no key published on keys.openpgp.org' (P091 cond 7). Armored keys are read only by the module's bounded OpenPGP packet reader (public-key and user-ID packets, length checks, 1 MB cap, P091 cond 2); otherwise existence only. Documented per-IP rate limits: 429 = RATE_LIMITED. Never cached (ttl 0). Used by pgp_keyservers.
